import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import ref
rng = random.Random(777)
n = int(sys.argv[1])
lens=[]
while len(lens) < n:
    lens += [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,96,112,127,128]
fib=[]; seen=set(); i=0
while len(fib) < n:
    L = lens[i]; i += 1
    while True:
        net = (rng.getrandbits(L) << (128-L)) if L else 0

            seen.add((net,L)); break

req = {'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':ref.fmt(a)+'/%d'%l,'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in fib],
       'capacities':[10**9]*16,'max_stride':32}
open('/app/tmp/gen_%d.json'%n,'w').write(json.dumps(req)+'\n')
print('n',n,'reqbytes',len(json.dumps(req)))
